rationale: The repeated bundles initially looked characteristic of mention-based enrichment.
Article-body review found direct applicability evidence for every article in the batch.
Evidence includes System Differences or System Variations sections, system comparison tables, system-specific sections, and explicit Modern Usage lists.
Bundle repetition alone is therefore not sufficient grounds for removal.
supersedes_recommendation: Do not apply the medium-confidence proposed removals in systems_applicability_audit.json.
